card.name: Be after 'should' in clinician instructions
card.fires_on: The word 'be' right after 'should' in label sentences telling the physician or the treating team what to do, such as 'the physician should be cautious' or 'management should be used'. Also 'and' after 'supine position' in hypotension instructions.

modes.label: should be
modes.description: The word 'be' after 'should' when the subject is a physician or the management of overdose.
modes.example: In the event of overdose, standard medical practice for the management of any overdose should<< be>> used.

modes.label: supine position and
modes.description: The word 'and' after 'place the patient in the supine position' before an if-necessary treatment step.
modes.example: If hypotension occurs, place the patient in the supine position<< and>>, if necessary, give intravenous normal

card.writes: It suppresses advice and counsel words, so the model is less likely to continue with advice-related wording.
card.plain: It fires on small words in label instructions to the clinician, like 'should be' or 'position and'.
